IF
UseStarted(_Char,S_DEN_TieflingRefugee004_Hay_a7c96f0a-dfc0-4c4f-a762-af09ae2bff24)
AND
DB_Players(_Char)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("DEN_General_HayReward")
THEN
QuestUpdate(_Char,"HIDDEN_WLD_Boosters","DEN_OxHayStack_Looted");

IF
DB_SwampedHero_LootedGear((ITEM)S_UNI_HAG_SwampedHero_OldFancyHelmet_000_53c63057-7776-4875-867b-17e1100ef93e)
AND
DB_SwampedHero_LootedGear((ITEM)S_UNI_HAG_SwampedHero_FancyOldGreatsword_000_7a1489f1-274a-42c0-befd-2e032eb6b867)
THEN
NOT DB_SwampedHero_GearIsLooted(0);
DB_SwampedHero_GearIsLooted(1);

PROC
PROC_ApplySavegamePatches()
AND
QRY_BG3_SaveGameIsOlderThan("Release Patch 7")
AND
DB_PartOfTheTeam(_Player)
AND
GetFlag((FLAG)FOR_DangerousBook_State_BookOwner_06022678-24ed-35af-de93-bd91abc02452, _Player, 1)
AND
Exists((ITEM)S_FOR_DangerousBook_Tome_73ea8888-ed82-4ca5-b9f9-0c9119873507, 1)
AND
IsDestroyed((ITEM)S_FOR_DangerousBook_Tome_73ea8888-ed82-4ca5-b9f9-0c9119873507, 0)
AND
NOT GetDirectInventoryOwner(S_FOR_DangerousBook_Tome_73ea8888-ed82-4ca5-b9f9-0c9119873507, _Player)
THEN
DB_FOR_DangerousBook_MoveTome(_Player);
PROC_FOR_DangerousBook_MoveTome();
